import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    
    static int add(int a, int b) {
        if ((a += b) >= mod) a -= mod;
        return a;
    }
    
    static int mult(int a, int b) {
        long t = 1L * a * b;
        if (t >= mod) t %= mod;
        return (int) t;
    }
    
    static class Matr<N, M> {
        int[][] dat;
        
        Matr() {
            dat = new int[N][M];
            init();
        }
        
        void init() {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    dat[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        void iden() {
            init();
            for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(N, M); i++) {
                dat[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }
        
        Matr<M, N> trans() {
            Matr<M, N> out = new Matr<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    out.dat[i][j] = dat[j][i];
                }
            }
            return out;
        }
        
        int[] getRow(int x) {
            return dat[x];
        }
        
        int get(int i, int j) {
            return dat[i][j];
        }
        
        void set(int i, int j, int val) {
            dat[i][j] = val;
        }
        
        Matr<N, M> add(Matr<N, M> a) {
            Matr<N, M> out = new Matr<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    out.dat[i][j] = add(dat[i][j], a.dat[i][j]);
                }
            }
            return out;
        }
        
        Matr<N, M> mult(int x) {
            Matr<N, M> out = new Matr<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    out.dat[i][j] = mult(dat[i][j], x);
                }
            }
            return out;
        }
    }
    
    static <X> Matr<Integer, Integer> multiply(Matr<Integer, Integer> a, Matr<Integer, Integer> b) {
        int N = a.dat.length;
        int X = a.dat[0].length;
        int M = b.dat[0].length;
        Matr<Integer, Integer> out = new Matr<>();
        out.init();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < X; j++) {
                if (a.dat[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < M; k++) {
                        out.dat[i][k] = add(out.dat[i][k], mult(a.dat[i][j], b.dat[j][k]));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        int K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        List<Integer> digit = new ArrayList<>();
        
        // Create arrays for matrices
        Matr[][] A = new Matr[65][35];
        Matr[][] S = new Matr[65][35];
        Matr[][] P = new Matr[65][35];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                A[i][j] = new Matr<>(35, 35);
                S[i][j] = new Matr<>(35, 35);
                P[i][j] = new Matr<>(35, 35);
            }
        }
        
        Matr ans = new Matr<>(35, 35);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            A[0][i].iden();
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                A[0][i].dat[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }
        
        long len = K;
        for (int i = 1; len <= n; i++, len *= K) {
            S[i-1][K-1] = A[i-1][K-1];
            for (int j = K-2; j >= 0; j--) {
                S[i-1][j] = multiply(A[i-1][j], S[i-1][j+1]);
            }
            P[i-1][0] = A[i-1][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                P[i-1][j] = multiply(P[i-1][j-1], A[i-1][j]);
            }
            A[i][0] = S[i-1][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                A[i][j] = multiply(S[i-1][j], P[i-1][j-1]);
            }
        }
        
        long temp = n;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digit.add((int)(temp % K));
            temp /= K;
        }
        
        int s = 0;
        ans.iden();
        for (int i = digit.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < digit.get(i); j++) {
                ans = multiply(ans, A[i][(j + s) % K]);
            }
            s = (s + digit.get(i)) % K;
        }
        
        int res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            res = add(res, ans.dat[i][K]);
        }
        System.out.println(res);
    }
    
    static class Matr<N, M> {
        int[][] dat;
        
        Matr(int n, int m) {
            dat = new int[n][m];
            init();
        }
        
        void init() {
            for (int i = 0; i < dat.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < dat[i].length; j++) {
                    dat[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        void iden() {
            init();
            for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(dat.length, dat[0].length); i++) {
                dat[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }
        
        Matr<M, N> trans() {
            Matr<M, N> out = new Matr<>(dat[0].length, dat.length);
            for (int i = 0; i < dat[0].length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < dat.length; j++) {
                    out.dat[i][j] = dat[j][i];
                }
            }
            return out;
        }
        
        int[] getRow(int x) {
            return dat[x];
        }
        
        int get(int i, int j) {
            return dat[i][j];
        }
        
        void set(int i, int j, int val) {
            dat[i][j] = val;
        }
        
        Matr<N, M> add(Matr<N, M> a) {
            Matr<N, M> out = new Matr<>(dat.length, dat[0].length);
            for (int i = 0; i < dat.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < dat[0].length; j++) {
                    out.dat[i][j] = add(dat[i][j], a.dat[i][j]);
                }
            }
            return out;
        }
        
        Matr<N, M> mult(int x) {
            Matr<N, M> out = new Matr<>(dat.length, dat[0].length);
            for (int i = 0; i < dat.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < dat[0].length; j++) {
                    out.dat[i][j] = mult(dat[i][j], x);
                }
            }
            return out;
        }
    }
}
